title: OmniAlign-V: Towards Enhanced Alignment of MLLMs with Human Preference
paper_type_zh: 多模态偏好数据集、构建流程与对齐评测论文
best_for_zh: 需要复用图像条件偏好对、审计 AI 评审负样本，或比较多模态 SFT 与 DPO 的研究者。
one_line: OmniAlign-V-DPO releases 150K image-grounded chosen-rejected pairs built from OmniAlign-V answers and model-sampled negative responses for MLLM preference optimization.
OmniAlign-V-DPO 将图像、开放式问题、优选回答和模型采样的劣选回答发布为 15 万条偏好对，用于多模态大语言模型的 DPO 对齐。
why: It makes the preference contract explicit for multimodal alignment: a detailed image-grounded answer is positive, while an intent-divergent sampled response is negative.
inclusion_reason: Officially released multimodal chosen-rejected records make preference feedback directly reusable for DPO-oriented MLLM alignment.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Open MLLMs may perform well on conventional visual QA yet still produce shallow, poorly instructed, or weakly grounded answers in open-ended image conversations. The paper treats this as a multimodal preference-alignment gap: improving text-only instruction data alone did not reliably improve it and could hurt visual capability.

The work addresses image-conditioned, open-ended requests rather than short-answer recognition. It builds visual question-answer data and paired responses so that models can learn to prefer detailed, instruction-following answers grounded in natural images and infographics.

开源多模态大语言模型即使在常见视觉问答中得分较高，也可能在开放式图文对话里给出浅显、不遵守指令或缺乏图像依据的回答。论文将其视为多模态偏好对齐缺口：仅增加文本指令数据并不能稳定改善这一问题，还可能损害视觉能力。

本文处理的是带图像条件的开放请求，而不是短答案识别。它构造视觉问答语料和成对回答，使模型学习偏向于自然图像和信息图中更完整、遵循指令且有视觉依据的回答。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: OmniAlign-V turns visual instruction answers into image-grounded preference pairs: the curated answer is chosen, while a LLaVA-NeXT response selected by an LLM judge as most inconsistent with the prompt intent and context is rejected. The released 150K pairs retain the image, prompt, and two responses, allowing DPO to learn from a visual comparison rather than a single answer. Unlike one-answer multimodal instruction corpora, its central contribution is this comparison; unlike text-only preference sets, the judgment remains tied to an image. Whether model-selected divergence reflects visual helpfulness rather than answer style remains an open question.

OmniAlign-V 将视觉指令回答转化为图像条件的偏好对：整理后的回答为优选，LLaVA-NeXT 生成、再由 LLM 评审为最偏离提示意图与上下文的回答为劣选。发布的 15 万对记录保留图像、提示和两个回答，使 DPO 能从视觉比较而非单一答案中学习。与每题只有一个回答的多模态指令语料不同，核心变化是加入可训练的比较；与纯文本偏好集不同，判断始终结合图像。这种模型选出的偏离是否真正反映视觉有用性，而非仅反映文风差异，仍有待进一步验证。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Select images. Input: public natural images and infographics. Operation: filter natural images with complexity and object signals. Output: semantically rich images; low-information images stop here.
  2. Generate SFT records. Input: selected images and task-specific prompts. Operation: GPT-4o writes open-ended questions and answers; chart answers combine complementary model outputs and receive human-expert review. Output: 205K visual instruction records.
  3. Create preference pairs. Input: an SFT answer and a LLaVA-NeXT baseline. Operation: sample alternatives at high temperature; an LLM judge selects the response most inconsistent with intent and context. Output: chosen/rejected records.
  4. Train and evaluate. Input: the released pairs. Operation: apply SFT then DPO and test held-out visual tasks. Check: use a fixed dataset revision, inspect image licenses, and compare training data with evaluation sets.

1. 筛选图像。输入是公开自然图像和信息图；操作是以复杂度与对象信号过滤自然图像；输出是语义丰富的图像，信息量不足的样本在此剔除。
  2. 生成 SFT 记录。输入是筛选后的图像和任务提示；操作是 GPT-4o 生成开放问题与回答，图表回答融合不同模型的互补结果并接受人类专家检查；输出为 20.5 万条视觉指令记录。
  3. 构造偏好对。输入是 SFT 回答和 LLaVA-NeXT 基线；操作是高温采样候选，再由 LLM 评审挑选最不符合意图与上下文的回答；输出是优选／劣选记录。
  4. 训练与评测。输入为发布的偏好对；操作是先做 SFT 再做 DPO，并在保留的视觉任务上测试；检查是固定数据版本、确认图像许可，并比较训练数据与评测集是否重叠。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Claim: adding the released pairs after OmniAlign-V SFT improves judged multimodal alignment. Setup: the same OmniAlign-V SFT model is compared before and after DPO. Result: MM-AlignBench rises from 57.1 / +11.1 to 64.3 / +22.4, and WildVision from 29.6 / -31.3 to 41.8 / -10.1; values are winning rate / reward. Boundary: this supports the reported DPO stage in this configuration, not a direct guarantee of human satisfaction.

Mechanism check: InternVL2-8B also rises from 31.4 / -21.8 to 64.7 / +19.4 on MM-AlignBench after DPO. That comparison supports portability beyond one base model, but MM-AlignBench uses GPT-4o judging against Claude3V-Sonnet references, so judge behavior remains part of the result.

主张：在 OmniAlign-V 的 SFT 之后加入公开偏好对，可提升多模态对齐的评审结果。设置：比较同一 SFT 模型在 DPO 前后。结果：MM-AlignBench 从 57.1／+11.1 升至 64.3／+22.4，WildVision 从 29.6／-31.3 升至 41.8／-10.1；数字为胜率／奖励。边界：这支持该配置下的 DPO 阶段，并非直接的人类满意度保证。

机制复核：InternVL2-8B 加入 DPO 后，MM-AlignBench 从 31.4／-21.8 升至 64.7／+19.4，说明增益不只出现在一个基础模型上。但 MM-AlignBench 由 GPT-4o 对照 Claude3V-Sonnet 参考回答评审，评审器行为仍影响结论。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier multimodal instruction corpora usually provide one answer for perception, OCR, or short visual QA. OmniAlign-V changes the training object to open-ended visual interaction and, crucially, adds a model-sampled, judge-selected rejected answer beside each curated positive answer. The change is therefore the feedback record and its decision point, not a new DPO objective. Its 150K-pair release makes the comparison reusable, but the order is mainly model-generated rather than a broad human annotation of safety, factuality, or culture.
此前多模态指令语料通常为感知、文字识别或短式视觉问答提供单一回答。OmniAlign-V 将训练对象改为开放图文交互，并把模型采样、经评审选择的劣选答案附在整理后的优选回答旁。真正改变的是反馈记录及其选择环节，而不是 DPO 目标本身。15 万对的发布使这种比较可复用，但排序主要由模型产生，并非覆盖安全、事实性或文化偏好的广泛人工标注。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The negative answer is selected by an LLM for intent/context divergence, not independently verified factual error. DPO may therefore learn judge-compatible style; sample pairs with human visual-grounding review.

The release inherits several image sources. License, redistribution rights, and evaluation overlap do not follow from the JSON schema; use a fixed revision and compare source material with intended benchmarks.

The main results partly rely on LLM judging and a 252-example benchmark. Check creative and infographic gains with independent human comparisons or another judge.

劣选答案由 LLM 按意图与上下文偏离程度选出，并非独立验证的事实错误。DPO 因而可能学习迎合评审器的文风；复用前应抽样进行人工视觉依据检查。

数据继承多个图像来源，JSON 字段不能证明许可、再分发权利或评测隔离。应固定版本、确认来源，并比较其与下游基准是否重叠。

主要结果部分依赖 LLM 评审和仅 252 条样本的基准。创作类与信息图结果应使用独立人工比较或另一评审器复核。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use the release to preference-tune an open MLLM for image-grounded, open-ended answers. Input is an image and prompt; train a DPO-compatible model to prefer chosen over rejected; output is an aligned visual-response policy. Check success on held-out, image-disjoint prompts and an evaluation not sharing the same judge lineage.

It is most suitable after visual instruction tuning and can also be used to examine model-generated negatives. Do not use it as human-authored ground truth, a general safety dataset, or a factual visual verifier. Download the image archives and check source rights before treating paths as portable.

该发布可用于在开放图文回答上微调开源多模态模型。输入是图像和提示；动作是在 DPO 中偏向 chosen 而非 rejected；输出是更贴合视觉上下文的回答策略。成功应在图像不重合的保留提示上检查，并采用不共享评审器来源的评测。

它适合接在视觉指令微调之后，也可用于观察模型生成负例。不要把它用作人类事实真值、通用安全数据或视觉事实验证器；下载图像包并确认来源权利后，才能移植图像路径。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. The record is image path, prompt, chosen, and rejected—not a text-only DPO example.
  2. LLaVA-NeXT samples negatives; an LLM judge chooses the most intent-inconsistent one.
  3. Keep 205K SFT records separate from the 150K released DPO pairs.
  4. The clearest result is the DPO gain after OmniAlign-V SFT; evaluation remains judge-based.
  5. Fix the Hugging Face revision and compare image rights and benchmark overlap before training.

1. 记录包含图像路径、提示、优选回答和劣选回答，不是纯文本 DPO 样本。
  2. LLaVA-NeXT 采样负例，LLM 评审选出最不符合意图的一条。
  3. 20.5 万条 SFT 记录与发布的 15 万条 DPO 对必须分开引用。
  4. 最直接的证据是 SFT 后加入 DPO 的增益，评测仍依赖评审器。
  5. 训练前固定 Hugging Face 版本，并比较图像权利与基准重叠。
